access.title: Network access
access.headlineFallback: Recover value from what your operations already produce
access.subtextFallback: Access to industrial demand and relevant recovery opportunities.

access.footerNote: Billing, invoicing, and payment rails are not activated in this phase. Enterprise access remains a structured placeholder for policy-heavy deployments.

conversations.threadClosed: This thread is closed to new messages.
